'''ECF One of a Kind Endor Op's''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ECF]]
* '''Published:''' 20 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 EOps ECF DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my curent Endor op's deck that I am playing it's meta for classic I will post later a full deck that's with most meta.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

This is a close to old school Endor op's as I go any more it's a drain on endor deck that work's with uncanceable drains. It's got a string space force to hold the system and good strong ground to play with. This deck has no Vitural set six in it yet as it was built about 2 month's ago. It still's play well and can hold it's own in the open play envoirment as well. there are changes that I would make to it in the open enviroment if I have time to make them but this is my standered Classic set up most of the time. Yes there is no Mara Jade in the Deck she was a tought cut to make but at 60 cards it's hard to have her in the deck.

The ground should set up as Bunnker, Platform, Dark Forest, Forest Clearing, Ewok Village. there is no bunnker don't want to let Light side into the bunker that easliy.

Well Like I stated I will get the standered deck up some time later this week.

Enjoy the Deck and Happy Holidays to All.

Responce: "Shewski     Why 2 EstablisheS? I like your idea about Presences, since like I told icy, your Drain Modifiers may be canceled, just the drain itself cannot be. I'd use ADLR (V) instead of DiPO now. I'm a bigger fan of BFBH than him in his ship, but it's your call. Nice deck." The 2 Establishes are a prefrence for me personaly. Yes the force darin's can't be canceled but the adders can I have know that from the bigging with test 1, but aginst fades I can make it hard for them to hold either a system or ground site. the ships are just that relly good ships that work very well in the deck I still would rather have the ships than the ADLR (V) and BFBH isn't leagle in clasic.
